name: emr
isa_scanned_on: pcl-spr10 (ISA/topology only; identical SKU to measurement node)
measured_reference_note: MEASURED on pcl-sprh02 (DDR5-5600), SLURM jobs 384146/384154, cores 0-63 NUMA0: STREAM Triad 64thr=276.7-279.3 GB/s; BF16 GEMM best=47.0 TF (median 46.4-46.5 @ dim12288, brg_matmul avx10_1_512_amx). These are REFERENCE OBSERVATIONS, not achievable targets and not the full observed gap as recoverable headroom. NOTE: the earlier 214.4 GB/s / 40.3 TF came from a DIFFERENT node pcl-spr10 (DDR5-4400, nominal peak 281.6 GB/s) -> do NOT mix. STREAM reports useful-byte BW, not controller traffic; AMX-load clock + DRAM-controller traffic not measured.

machine_peak.mem_bw_derivation: 8 channels x DDR5-5600 MT/s x 8 B = 358.4 GB/s per socket (ONE NUMA domain, SNC off). Datasheet theoretical peak.
machine_peak.amx_bf16_derivation: 64 cores x 1024 bf16 FLOP/cyc/core (AMX TMUL 16x16x32 = 16384 FLOP / 16 cyc) x 1.9 GHz NOMINAL BASE CLOCK = 124.5184 TFLOP/s. 1.9 GHz is the 8592+ base clock (reference anchor, NOT a measured all-core AMX frequency). Set amx_bf16_ghz_ref to 2.3 (->150.7) or 2.9 (->190.1) for a higher machine-peak assumption.
machine_peak.avx512_fp32_derivation: AMX does NOT execute FP32; FP32 GEMM runs on AVX-512 FMA. 64 cores x 2 FMA units x 16 fp32 lanes x 2 (mul+add) = 64 FLOP/cyc/core x 1.9 GHz NOMINAL BASE CLOCK = 7.7824 TFLOP/s. Nominal reference ceiling for FP32 compute rows (e.g. MHC); NOT measured.
machine_peak.note: ROOFLINE CEILING for Phase A = these datasheet machine-peak numbers. The measured REFERENCE OBSERVATION on the measurement node (mem_bw_gbps=277.0, amx_bf16_tflops=47.0) is a lower-bound observation of achievable throughput; the gap to machine peak is NOT assumed fully recoverable (STREAM useful-byte BW != controller traffic; AMX-load clock not measured). Surface the residual gap when an op plateaus below the ceiling.

measured_how: MEASURED 2026-10-08 on the measurement node pcl-sprh02 (DDR5-5600), SLURM 384146/384154, numactl cores 0-63 NUMA0 (ONE socket = ONE NUMA domain, SNC off). BW=276.7-279.3 GB/s (STREAM Triad 64thr). AMX bf16=47.0 TF best (median 46.4-46.5 @ dim12288, brg_matmul avx10_1_512_amx). These are REFERENCE OBSERVATIONS (lower bounds), not achievable targets and not recoverable-headroom estimates. The earlier 214.4 GB/s / 40.3 TF were from a DIFFERENT node (pcl-spr10, DDR5-4400) and are NOT used. The Phase-A roofline ceiling is machine_peak (above). Decode is BW-bound across M{1..64} regardless of exact compute peak; AMX peak governs only compute-bound attention + prefill.
